title: Mia's Week: A New Routine with Changes · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写6—8句、至少40词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message about your weekly routine. Use I, we, or they. Include one change this week and give a reason. Use time words like at, on, usually, sometimes.
Write 6–8 complete sentences and at least 40 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
